description: This file defines the FloatingRateRepositoryWrapper class, which provides a higher-level interface for accessing and manipulating FloatingRate entities, including retrieval, saving, and exception handling for not-found cases.

classes.name: FloatingRateRepositoryWrapper
classes.description: A service class that wraps a FloatingRateRepository to provide methods for retrieving, saving, and handling floating rate data.

methods.name: retrieveBaseLendingRate
methods.description: Returns the base lending rate by delegating to the underlying repository.

methods.name: findOneWithNotFoundDetection
methods.description: Finds a FloatingRate by ID, throwing a FloatingRateNotFoundException if not found.

methods.name: saveAndFlush
methods.description: Saves and flushes a FloatingRate entity for updates.
